How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here’s how to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in a lovely branded box or envelope. If it’s a gift, you can upgrade to a luxury gift box for an extra special touch.
Wear It Last: When getting ready, put your jewellery on after applying perfumes, lotions, or makeup to avoid any contact with chemicals.
Daily Use: Many of our stainless steel pieces are water-resistant, so they can handle splashes or light exposure to water. Just avoid harsh chemicals or prolonged soaking.
Care for It: Wipe it gently after wearing to remove oils or dirt, and store it in its box to keep it safe and shiny.
Enjoy showing off your beautiful new piece! Let me know if you need more tips. 🧡
